main_measure.name: mean short-side excess next-day return on case bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, same-day cases summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2.0 over >= 30 case-days; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2.0 over >= 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean excess, split at median |forecast|

decided_by: t between -2.0 and 2.0 (or sign and t disagree), meeting neither confirm nor reject
reading: cases are bars where the short forecast deepens by >= 2 points from its lowest short level since the last bet (reset at flat), the mean is over cases and the t over day-summed cases, the upper half is |forecast| strictly above the median, and fewer than 30 case-days is treated as not observable
